actives.name: Barrier
actives.text: A Shield of 30% of the ally's max HP.

actives.name: Bulwark
actives.text: A Shield of 15% of max HP on every ally in the burst.

actives.name: Dispel
actives.text: Remove every buff from an enemy.

actives.name: Purge
actives.text: Remove one buff from every enemy.

actives.name: Reflect
actives.text: For 300 ticks, enemy spells aimed at the ally strike their caster instead.

actives.name: Flame Brand
actives.text: An ally's weapon strikes as Fire for 300 ticks.

actives.name: Frost Brand
actives.text: An ally's weapon strikes as Water for 300 ticks.

actives.name: Storm Brand
actives.text: An ally's weapon strikes as Wind for 300 ticks.

actives.name: Stone Brand
actives.text: An ally's weapon strikes as Earth for 300 ticks.

actives.name: Dawn Brand
actives.text: An ally's weapon strikes as Holy for 300 ticks.

actives.name: Dusk Brand
actives.text: An ally's weapon strikes as Dark for 300 ticks.

actives.name: Thorn Ward
actives.text: Melee attackers take 30% of their damage back for 300 ticks.

actives.name: Silence
actives.text: Silence for 200 ticks; cancels a spell being charged.

actives.name: Anchor
actives.text: Immune to Readiness damage, Knockdown and Charm for 300 ticks.

actives.name: Null Zone
actives.text: Enemies in the band cannot cast for 200 ticks.

passives.name: Counterspell
passives.text: When an adjacent ally is targeted by a spell, a 25% chance to Dispel it.

passives.name: Thick Skin
passives.text: Shell on self at battle start.

passives.name: Ward-Sense
passives.text: Enemy buffs are shown with their remaining ticks.
